study_design: Pooled prospective cohort analysis of three Copenhagen cohorts
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The study population consisted of 12,989 subjects drawn from three different cohorts.
reason: The prospective analysis reports incident prostate cancer overall and does not define or analyze an aggressive prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Furthermore, drinkers of more than 13 beers, 13 glasses of wine, and 13 drinks of spirits had a risk of 1.03 (CI: 0.67, 1.60), 0.92 (CI: 0.42, 1.99), and 1.01 (CI: 0.52, 1.98), respectively, compared with abstainers of the given beverage of alcohol.
estimate_classifications.reason: The beer estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, with no aggressive disease restriction.
